mapper.select: SELECT count(1) FROM ALL_TABLES WHERE table_name = UPPER(#{tableName}) and OWNER = #{currentSchema}
mapper.update: CREATE TABLE ${tableName} AS SELECT s.* FROM T_ER_SRCLIST_TONEWSYS s WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM T_DA_DATA_TONEWSYS d WHERE s.erid = d.erid AND d.unitid = '${unitid}' )
CREATE TABLE ${tableName} AS SELECT a.* FROM T_ER_STOREITEM_TONEWSYS a WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ${srcTableName} s WHERE a.id = s.STOREITEMID )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO aaa (QZH, TABLENAME, VOLUME, STATUS, BEGINTIME, ENDTIME, PID) VALUES ( #{qzh, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tableName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{volume, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{status, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{beginTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{endTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{pid, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT QZH, TABLENAME, VOLUME, STATUS, BEGINTIME, ENDTIME, PID FROM aaa ORDER BY BEGINTIME DESC
